_comment: Copy to ops/synth_targets.json (git-ignored: addresses, key paths and stack names stay on the operator's machine). Only TEST stacks are listed: a name starting with syn-, or a guest made by provision_guest.sh with "guest": true. EVERY target must also say, in this file, either "no_telegram": true (the operator states the stack has no Telegram bot) or "test_bot": true (its bot belongs to nobody): the harness cannot see a stack's bot token or whether a stack is a guest, so a target that says neither is refused, and so is one marked "telegram": true without "test_bot". Check it first (SYNTHETIC_DAY.md section 10, preflight). Keys are read from a file or a variable and never written to a report. Mode a needs fake_llm and probes every target before the day.

syn-burger-main.label: burger-all-roles
syn-burger-main.key_file: <path to a file holding this stack's API key>
syn-burger-main.state_db: <optional: a readable copy or mount of this stack's Hermes state.db, for per-turn tokens in mode b>

logs.waker: <a text export of the waker journal, optional>

cap_check_cmd: <optional argv: exits non-zero when a provider cap is approached>
on_kill_cmd: <optional argv run once when the run is stopped, e.g. to put the test stacks to sleep>
